docking.correction_note: Pipeline docked BI-3406 (-8.88) on 6V9M, but the centre audit shows 6V9M's largest drug-like HETATM group is GNP, a GTP analogue bound to KRAS chain A — the drug was docked into the KRAS GTP pocket, not SOS1. That score is DISCARDED. 6SCM is BI-3406's own co-crystal; this run docks BI-3406 + MRTX0902 + BAY-293 on it. BI-3406 itself never entered the clinic; clinical data belong to analogue BI 1701963.
